notes: No review posted (Codex found nothing to flag on a two-line protective config change); zero findings across zero rounds, so adjudication is n/a (zero valid-finding denominator) rather than never-run or completed. **2026-08-15 /maintenance staleness sweep.** This record's null `reviewInterval` was re-checked and is retained, but the reason was nearly recorded wrong. The sweep first read "no Codex comment" as "never reviewed"; the PR in fact carries exactly one 👍 reaction and nothing else, which is the connector's own documented clean-pass signal ("If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍"). Reaction authorship is not exposed by the GitHub access available here, so this is strong evidence rather than proof — but the timing agrees (see below), and this record's original note already read it as a silent clean pass, which was correct. **The measurement consequence is real either way:** `loop-metrics.mjs` counts `**Reviewed commit:**` markers, and a 👍-only pass emits none, so a clean review is indistinguishable from no review in the mechanical half. That is a second blind spot alongside the review-body findings gap recorded on #447. Numbers left as derived rather than hand-corrected, per the never-type-mechanical-values rule. Open 11 minutes — the one PR of this group where a review genuinely could have been outrun.
